title: Denial of Service in DefaultPluginManager in Apache JSPWIKI versions prior to the fixed version on all platforms…
description: A denial of service vulnerability exists in the DefaultPluginManager component of Apache JSPWIKI versions prior to 3.0.1. This flaw allows an attacker to spawn multiple threads, potentially exhausting system resources, or to load and instantiate any class available on the classpath. The issue is fixed in version 3.0.1, and users are advised to upgrade to this version to mitigate the risk.
